description: Unit tests for LoadBalancerConfig class in the quiche QUIC load balancer implementation, testing configuration creation, encryption/decryption, and block encryption.

classes.name: LoadBalancerConfigTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for LoadBalancerConfig unit tests.

methods.name: InvalidParams
methods.description: Tests invalid configuration parameters and expects specific bug reports.

methods.name: ValidParams
methods.description: Tests creation of valid configurations and verifies accessor methods.

methods.name: TestEncryptionPassExample
methods.description: Verifies encryption pass results against known example from draft-ietf-quic-load-balancers-15.

methods.name: EncryptionPassPlaintext
methods.description: Ensures that encryption pass on unencrypted config does not alter data.

methods.name: EncryptionPassesAreReversible
methods.description: Checks that encryption passes can be reversed, restoring original data.

methods.name: InvalidBlockEncryption
methods.description: Tests block encryption/decryption with invalid configurations.

methods.name: BlockEncryptionExample
methods.description: Validates block encryption/decryption against known test vector.

methods.name: ConfigIsCopyable
methods.description: Verifies that LoadBalancerConfig objects can be copied and used interchangeably.
